# TalentFlow Revenue Engine

> AI-powered recruitment automation: interviews, LOI, joining, billing, collections, and legal escalation in one dashboard.

TalentFlow automates the full recruitment-to-payment lifecycle for staffing companies — candidate sourcing, interview reminders, joining confirmation, Performa/Tax invoicing, 15-stage collection follow-up at 13:00 IST, and legal escalation. Includes a server-side scheduler with idempotent dispatch and a payment-stop rule that cancels reminders the moment a case is marked paid.
